svg.title: CPMMIS Cost-Benefit Analysis at a Glance
svg.desc: One-page cost-benefit summary for the Capstone Project Management and Monitoring Information System, including development and operating costs, annual benefits, cumulative net benefit, payback period, and sensitivity analysis.
svg.text: CPMMIS — Cost-Benefit Analysis at a Glance
Capstone Project Management & Monitoring Information System · 8-month base case (32 weeks) · Philippine pesos at 2026 price levels
Non-personnel: equipment depreciation, Internet, hosting, printing, and 10% contingency.
Software licenses: ₱0 — open-source PHP, MariaDB, Laragon, Git, Tailwind, and Chart.js.
Full economic cost · 5-year view · break-even in year 1.36
Cumulative net benefit = annual benefit − operating cost − development cost.
Quantified recurring value at 100 capstone groups
Sources: recovered staff and student time, avoided printing, faster retrieval, fewer lost documents.
Full economic cost · sensitivity of payback and 3-year BCR
Development cash outlay ₱100,100 · Year 1 cash cost ₱175,340 · Year 1 net cash benefit ₱175,660
Cash payback ≈ 4 months of operation; this is the institution's actual cash view.
Full economic cost remains the correct basis for comparing CPMMIS with a commercially developed system.
Use this variant if the manuscript follows the 7-phase Gantt schedule instead of the 32-week base case.
Planning estimates in Philippine pesos at 2026 price levels. Benefits assume 100 capstone groups, 12 advisers, and 2 admin staff.
Software licenses: ₱0 · open-source stack (PHP, MariaDB, Laragon, Git, GitHub Free, Tailwind, Chart.js).
